Dynamic DP (动态 DP): a tree DP must be answered again after each point change. Maximum-weight independent set: f[u][0] = Σ max(f[v][0], f[v][1]), f[u][1] = w[u] + Σ f[v][0]. Split the children into the heavy child s and light children, and collect the light part in g[u][0] = Σlight max(f[v][0], f[v][1]), g[u][1] = w[u] + Σlight f[v][0]. Then the step along the heavy edge is a (max, +) matrix product: (f[u][0], f[u][1]) = [[g0, g0], [g1, −∞]] ⊗ (f[s][0], f[s][1]).

Keep these 2 × 2 matrices in a segment tree over HLD order (拓展篇 / 进阶篇第9章). A chain's product gives the f values of its top. A change at x updates x's matrix, then climbs: each chain top's new f changes its parent's g (a light edge), so O(log n) chains × O(log n) segment tree = O(log² n) per change (P4719).

Update g of the parent with the difference between the chain top's new and old f, computed before and after the segment tree update; recomputing g from scratch would cost O(degree). The product order must follow the chain from top to bottom.
Weighted BST per chain; depth O(log n).

A global balanced binary tree (全局平衡二叉树) replaces the segment trees of heavy-light decomposition. For each heavy chain build a binary search tree over the chain, choosing as root the vertex that splits the chain by weight, where a vertex's weight is 1 + the sizes of its light subtrees. Light edges hang the chain trees together into one tree of depth O(log n) in total, not O(log² n).

In dynamic DP (第 1 节) every update walks from a vertex to the root and fixes one matrix per node: with HLD that is O(log² n) segment-tree work, with the global balanced tree it is O(log n). Each node stores the product of the matrices in its BST subtree (its own light-child matrix in the middle); a light-edge step updates the parent chain's light matrix, exactly as in the HLD version. Used for the " 加强版 " (strengthened) dynamic DP problem P4751, where O(log² n) is too slow.
Build by weight, not by count: choosing the middle vertex by count gives O(log² n) depth again. The tree is static: it does not support link / cut (use LCT for that).
